mio.configuration.title: Mio
mio.configuration.executablePath.descrip: Absolute path to the Mio CLI. Leave empty to search for mio/mio.exe on PATH.
mio.configuration.diagnostics.enabled.de: Show diagnostics. The MioCore language server provides them while it is running; otherwise the Mio CLI check command is used as a fallback.
mio.configuration.diagnostics.onSave.des: Fallback only: automatically run mio check after saving a .mio file when the language server is unavailable.
mio.configuration.outputDirectory.descri: Output directory for mio build. Leave empty to write the .mochi file next to the source file. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.
mio.command.check.title: Check Current File
mio.command.run.title: Run Current File
mio.command.build.title: Build Current File
mio.command.version.title: Show Compiler Version
mio.command.output.title: Open Output
mio.configuration.languageServer.enabled: Start the MioCore language server from the Mio CLI (mio lsp). When it is unavailable, diagnostics fall back to mio check.
